name: Fresh Splashes
summary: Swaps the yellow title screen splash texts for hundreds of new, original lines about mining, mobs, farming and life in a blocky world.
logoPrompt: A bright yellow speech bubble made of glowing blocks, tilted at an angle and bursting with small sparkles, floating above a single grass block

cover.tagline: Hundreds of new title screen splashes.

description: **Fresh Splashes gives the title screen hundreds of new yellow splash texts, so the line next to the logo surprises you again.**
- Replaces the vanilla splash list with a long list of new lines written for this pack.
- Covers mining, farming, animals, monsters, villages, the Nether, the End, redstone and building.
- Every line is short enough to read at a glance and suits players of all ages.
- The special date splashes of the game still show up on their days.

Put the zip into the `resourcepacks` folder of your game and turn it on under Options > Resource Packs. A new splash is picked each time the game starts or you return to the title screen from a world.
- Made for Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3. It only changes one text file, so you can add or remove it at any time.
- Each player sees the splashes of their own resource packs.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Have an idea for a splash? Leave a comment.
